The same first-party surface identifies Powy as a brand of TheF Charging S.r.l., matching partyId PWY scope.

PWY.tariffChannel: Powy Charge app / Direct Payment QR / POS; roaming eMSP explicitly separate

feesAndConditions.appPromotionCaveat: Powy Charge app tariffs may differ when an active promotion applies; use the published direct base grid unless a station-specific promotion is explicitly proven.
feesAndConditions.roaming: Third-party eMSP tariffs are not covered and remain separate.

positiveEvidenceAppend: Fresh first-party Powy Costi di ricarica page crawled 2026-09-14 states prices are updated and apply exclusively to Powy Charge, Direct Payment QR and POS.
The same page publishes the complete Italy power grid: AC <=22 kW 0.72 EUR/kWh; DC 23-60 kW 0.88; DC+ 61-149 kW 0.92; HPC >=150 kW 0.97, VAT included.
Direct Payment/POS carry a 0.40 EUR activation commission while Powy Charge does not; occupancy penalties start 60 minutes after charge end, with AC waived 23:00-07:00.
Powy first-party charging page links the live guest Direct Payment surface https://direct.powy.energy/ and states QR/code selection of the exact outlet before payment.
First-party footer identifies Powy as a brand by TheF Charging S.r.l., matching the PWY canonical legal operator.
negativeEvidenceAppend: Roaming/eMSP prices can differ and are explicitly excluded from the direct tariff mapping.
Powy Charge may expose station-specific promotional prices; such promotions must not be extrapolated beyond explicitly eligible stations.
The current HTML table does not expose a DC+ occupancy value in the extracted row; do not invent one. Energy price remains deterministic.
PWY.mappingRule: Map each PWY EVSE by connector current type and rated power to the exact official Italy class: AC <=22; DC 23-60; DC+ 61-149; HPC >=150. Apply direct energy price and channel-specific activation fee. Preserve any explicit station promotion as an override only when directly evidenced.
